title: Federal workforce separations: simulation against OPM's records
subtitle: OPM Federal Workforce Data
takeaways: From 2025-02 to 2025-12, the simulation's error in each agency's monthly separations was 46.3% (accuracy 53.7%), against 55.7% for the best series method (Same month last year).
The programme calculation that applies the same published effects to whole agencies was at 40.9%.
Total separations: actual 366,779, simulation 245,462, Same month last year 203,364.
In the development years without a policy change the simulation's error was 19.3% against 18.3% for Exponential smoothing.
Alternative (no resignation offer): 192,528 separations instead of 245,462 with the same seeds.

sections.heading: Error in each agency's monthly separations, by cutoff
How the prediction was made
sections.body: At each December cutoff, every agency's employees become cohort twins with separation rates fitted on records published by the cutoff; predict each agency's separations in each month from February to December of the next year; average 20 runs. rates fitted on separations recorded by each cutoff; specification chosen on the development cutoffs; priors cite work published before January 2025.
